Load 26 update entry: load X from $4DBD and write $09 to $4DCB,X. If either $4DB6 or $4DB3 is nonzero, write $FF to the horizontal-motion gate $E1 and leave the index at $8FCF unchanged. Otherwise read the six-byte pattern at $8FD0 using that index, store the value at $E1, increment the index and reset it when it reaches 6. The index is not locally bounded before the read. It then jumps to $8FD6, which advances through $0732 when column $6F3C is zero and otherwise jumps to $0200. The entry overlaps the captured character-copy source. The resident left and right speed-update paths at $0E58 and $0FF2 return early when the gate is zero. The conditions were tested with controlled inputs.

Load 26: six gate values $FF, $00, $00, $FF, $00, $00, read at $8FB6 with Y = the index at $8FCF. The update routine at $8FA1 writes the selected value to $E1 when $4DB6 and $4DB3 are both zero, and $FF otherwise.
